remarks: Welcome to Darien Place, a thoughtfully designed residence built in 2021 that seamlessly blends the character of the original 1928 brick structure with modern living. This 1-bedroom, 1-bath home features 9+ foot ceilings, exposed brick, and an open layout to flood the space with natural light.   The kitchen is appointed with Bosch appliances and clean, modern finishes, while the spacious bedroom with ensuite full bath includes a walk-in shower. Additional features include in-unit washer and dryer and privacy window treatments.  The building offers controlled access to the lobby, elevator, and stairwell. One reserved parking space and a private storage cage are included.  Ideally located in the heart of downtown Darien, with close proximity to restaurants, shopping, train, library, and everyday conveniences. No smoking. Pet restrictions apply; please inquire to learn more.
